head.description: Hire Elianchox for your web and mobile development projects. Over 4 years of experience creating innovative and efficient solutions.

hero.title: Hey, I'm Elian Ramírez
hero.description: 3+ years of experience as a Web and Mobile Applications Developer from Barranquilla, Colombia 🇨🇴. Specialized in building efficient and scalable web and mobile applications.

data.title: Enternova S.A.S.
data.role: Full Stack Developer & AI Workflow Engineer
description: Designed and implemented an AI-assisted development pipeline — plan architecture and tasks with AI agents, generate code through automated workflows, and enforce quality via systematic code review — accelerating delivery while maintaining high standards.
Developed frontend features in React for a supply management platform, including procurement modules, contract and rate management, and ticketing systems, with continuous UI/UX improvements.
Established frontend standards, reusable component libraries, and code conventions that improved maintainability across the project and accelerated onboarding for new team members.
Collaborated closely with backend and product teams in agile sprints, translating business requirements into technical solutions and ensuring cohesive, high-quality deliveries.

data.title: Tobiro S.A.S.
description: Structured and implemented frontend modules in React following established design guidelines.
Developed features for bulk and individual client uploads, optimizing the data management process.
Fixed production-reported issues, improving stability and overall user experience.

data.title: Byteware IT Group S.A.S.
description: Developed Neuse, a residential management platform with mobile (Flutter) and web (React) apps for residents, guards, and administrators.
Implemented real-time voting and QR-based visitor validation, increasing participation and reducing gate registration time by 50%.
Automated administrative records (parking, apartments, etc.), reducing errors and manual work.
Independently led the frontend, optimizing user flows and integrating smoothly with the backend.

data.title: LyA Electronic
description: Developed over three web and mobile apps (React, React Native, Flutter), including a ride-hailing platform (Anngel), achieving a functional MVP in six months and improving performance (+40% in Lighthouse, load time up to 1.4 s).
Established a standard architecture in React and a reusable components library, accelerating development and improving onboarding.
Led the technical frontend, coordinating with backend, proposing GitFlow, and managing user stories to enhance planning and production support.

data.title: 4Visum POS
data.description: Dual POS system for restaurants and bars. Combines a web administration panel (Next.js 16, Prisma 7, PostgreSQL) with a mobile QR-based customer ordering app. Integrated with Wompi digital payments, featuring multi-tenant support, real-time order management, and role-based access control.

data.title: Anngel - Emergency Platform
data.description: Mobile app similar to Uber for emergency services, allowing users to request quick and efficient help during critical situations.

data.title: Neuse - Residential Management
data.description: Residential management platform with mobile and web apps for residents, guards, and administrators, making communication and administration easier in residential communities.

aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.data:
I'm Elian Ramírez, a web and mobile developer with over three years of experience. I'm passionate about creating efficient and scalable interfaces, focusing on performance and user experience.

My career has evolved from hands-on development to an integrated workflow where I plan architecture and tasks with AI, generate code through AI agents, and conduct thorough code review before deployment. This approach has significantly increased delivery speed while maintaining high quality standards.

I've led frontend and full-stack development at companies like LyA Electronic and Byteware, building React, Flutter, and Node.js platforms that optimized internal processes and improved delivery speed. Currently, at Enternova S.A.S., I contribute to a Project and Administration Management System (SGPA) while pioneering AI-assisted development workflows.

My goal is to continue growing in modern frontend development, now leveraging AI to amplify my impact — focusing more on architecture, code quality, and developer productivity.
